title: Titan Legs
description: Powerful leg strength work with reverse lunges and pulse squats, finished with anti-rotation core

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.instructions: Run in place, heels toward the glutes

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate rounding and arching your back, breathe

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.instructions: Lunge + torso rotation + arm toward the sky

exercises.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
exercises.instructions: On one leg, lean your torso forward, back leg extended

exercises.name: Reverse lunges
exercises.instructions: Big step backward, lower the knee

exercises.name: Pulse squats
exercises.instructions: Stay at the bottom of the squat, small up-down pulses

exercises.name: Superman plank
exercises.instructions: In a plank, lift one arm and the opposite leg, alternate

exercises.name: Russian twists
exercises.instructions: Seated, feet lifted, rotate torso left and right

exercises.name: Leg raises
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, lift straight legs to vertical

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply
